gloss: sad news; news of a death

definitions.gloss: sad news; news of a death
definitions.explanation: A report of something sad, especially someone's death. On the internet it is also a jokey headline label for minor disappointments.

examples.japanese: {悲報|ひほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悲報|ひほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|せっ}した→接する：12920_sessuru⟧。
examples.english: I received the sad news of my former teacher's death.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ちょっとした→ちょっとした：27439_chottoshita⟧⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧な⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧「{悲報|ひほう}」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{見出|みだ}し→見出し：04440_midashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}けられる→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Online, even small letdowns sometimes get the headline label "sad news".

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲報|ひほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: sad news arrives
- {悲報|ひほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧: to receive sad news (formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {訃報|ふほう}: an announcement of someone's death; the standard term in newspapers and formal notices.
- {朗報|ろうほう}: good news, the opposite. Online, 【{悲報|ひほう}】 and 【{朗報|ろうほう}】 are paired headline tags used half-jokingly.
